validity.recommendation: No change to existence/classification/duplicate status recommended. Recommend a future pass specifically search for a post-2022 document isolating Stage III's own design/approval status (the underlying Glavgosexpertiza filings site, or a FOIA-style Karelia government document request, may be the only route -- public news coverage consistently discusses only Stages I+II when giving concrete milestones).
